question: Which shop categories get viewed the most?
golden_sql: SELECT c.categoriesname, COUNT(v.id) AS total_views FROM categories c JOIN shop_details sd ON sd.category_id = c.id JOIN views v ON v.shop_id = sd.id GROUP BY c.id, c.categoriesname ORDER BY total_views DESC;
